strings.hf.title: Abandoned Hospital
strings.hf.tagline: In a hospital closed for years, your name is already in the records. Between a patient badge, Room 14, and rooms still lit up, everything suggests your arrival was expected.
strings.hf.s01.title: The Gate
strings.hf.s01.body: The gate is locked, but the chain hangs loose, as if it was cut recently. Behind it, the hospital is almost completely dark. A neon light flickers every other second.
strings.hf.s02.title: The Cut Chain
strings.hf.s02.body: The chain on the ground is warm. No fresh rust, no dust on it. As if it had just been placed there.
strings.hf.s03.title: The New Sign
strings.hf.s03.body: Under the old "CLOSED," a fresh paper reads: "EXPECTED PATIENT — AUTOMATIC ADMISSION." Your name is typed at the bottom. No first name.
strings.hf.s03.c1: Take a picture of the paper
strings.hf.s04.title: No Signal
strings.hf.s04.body: Your phone shows zero bars. Then the screen lights up on its own: "On-duty staff: present." You look up. A window on the second floor has just gone dark.
strings.hf.s04.c3: Go in while following the window with your eyes into the hallway
strings.hf.s05.title: The Lobby
strings.hf.s05.body: A smell of warm chlorine hangs in the air. The tile floor is wet in the middle, as if someone just mopped it. Everything is too clean for a closed place.
strings.hf.s06.title: Reception Desk
strings.hf.s06.body: A bell, an open register, a printed paper badge... dated today. The computer screen shows a blinking cursor: "FILE: IN PROGRESS."
strings.hf.s06.c3: Try the elevator in the back
strings.hf.s07.title: Main Hallway
strings.hf.s07.body: The hallway feels unnaturally long. Every door looks the same. At the end, a sign reads: "CONSULTATIONS," and farther on: "STAIRS — LEVEL -1."
strings.hf.s08.title: Intercom
strings.hf.s08.body: The bell rings. One second later, the intercom crackles: "You are late. Present your wristband." You do not have a wristband.
strings.hf.s09.title: Admission Register
strings.hf.s09.body: Your name is already written there, the ink dry. Room 14. The next line says: "Wristband to be collected." An arrow in pen points toward the rooms.
strings.hf.s09.c1: Sign it as if it were normal
strings.hf.s09.c3: Ignore it and head back to the hallway
strings.hf.s10.title: Badge "Patient"
strings.hf.s10.body: A printer spits out a paper badge: "PATIENT — ON DUTY." It has your height, your weight... exact numbers. Far too exact.
strings.hf.s10.c2: Slip it into your pocket, then follow the arrow toward the rooms
strings.hf.s11.title: Room 14
strings.hf.s11.body: The bed is unmade, still warm near the pillow. On the bedside table: a patient wristband. The heart monitor is off, but its LEDs are blinking slowly.
strings.hf.s11.c1: Take the wristband from the table
strings.hf.s11.c2: Press the call button and follow the sound into the hallway
strings.hf.s12.title: Warm Wristband
strings.hf.s12.body: The wristband has your name on it. When you touch it, you feel a faint vibration in the plastic.
strings.hf.s12.c2: Put it in your pocket and follow the hallway to the office
strings.hf.s13.title: The Frozen Elevator
strings.hf.s13.body: The elevator doors are slightly open onto darkness. The "-1" button is scratched, as if someone tried to rip it off. A metallic smell comes from the cabin.
strings.hf.s13.c1: Try to force the doors open
strings.hf.s14.title: Radiology
strings.hf.s14.body: The machine is in standby. A screen shows an X-ray already loaded, as if it were waiting for you. The humming is too steady to come from a machine just sitting idle.
strings.hf.s14.c1: Look at the X-ray on the screen
strings.hf.s14.c3: Go back to the main hallway
strings.hf.s15.title: Impossible X-ray
strings.hf.s15.body: The X-ray shows a chest... and, at the center, a dark rectangle, like the space for a paper file folder. At the bottom, a stamp reads: "PATIENT 0 — ARCHIVES."
strings.hf.s15.c3: Follow the light at the end of the hallway
strings.hf.s16.title: The Chapel
strings.hf.s16.body: In a niche, three candles are still burning, wax still fresh. A prayer book lies open to a blank page, except for one sentence: "ON DUTY = YOU."
strings.hf.s16.c2: Follow the silent hallway to the office
strings.hf.s17.title: Door "Consultations"
strings.hf.s17.body: A white door with a scanner. On the scanner screen: "PRESENT WRISTBAND." Behind the door, you can hear a cart rolling slowly.
strings.hf.s18.title: Doctor's Office
strings.hf.s18.body: The office is too neat. A tape recorder sits in the center, cassette inside. A note reads: "Do not let the patient leave without proof."
strings.hf.s18.c1: Go through the half-open door toward the stairs
strings.hf.s18.c3: Look for a map in the drawers
strings.hf.s19.title: The Shifting Hallway
strings.hf.s19.body: The moment you step through the door, the hallway is no longer the same. An intersection appears where there used to be only a wall. The neon lights are no longer aligned.
strings.hf.s19.c2: Follow the sound of the cart
strings.hf.s20.title: Stairwell
strings.hf.s20.body: A sign says "Level -1." The air rising from below is damp and cold. You hear a steady breathing sound in the stairwell.
strings.hf.s20.c2: Go back up to the hallway
strings.hf.s21.title: Level -1
strings.hf.s21.body: Pipes drip overhead. At the end, a door marked "SECURITY." Farther on, another marked "SURVEILLANCE." The light seems to come from the floor.
strings.hf.s22.title: Security Station
strings.hf.s22.body: The screens are black, but the fan is running. On a hook: access cards. On the wall, an evacuation map with an exit to the courtyard.
strings.hf.s22.c3: Search the metal cabinet, then head toward the locker room
strings.hf.s23.title: Evacuation Map
strings.hf.s23.body: The map shows: "COURTYARD EXIT." A note in marker says: "Without proof, back to the OR." You have the feeling that message is meant for you.
strings.hf.s24.title: Door "Archives"
strings.hf.s24.body: A gray door with a badge reader. The label is new: "PATIENT 0." You are sure you had not seen it before.
strings.hf.s24.c3: Go back to the evacuation map
strings.hf.s25.title: Archives
strings.hf.s25.body: Tall shelves. Boxes. Files. And on a table, an open binder on a blank page. The dust is marked with fresh fingerprints.
strings.hf.s26.title: The Files Move
strings.hf.s26.body: The files are moving slightly. Every time you breathe in, one binder lifts a little.
strings.hf.s26.c1: Pull the file that moves the most
strings.hf.s27.title: Your Name on the File
strings.hf.s27.body: You finally find it: "PATIENT 0." On the label: your name. Under it, a date... tomorrow. The cardboard is cold despite the damp air.
strings.hf.s27.c3: Take the file with you and go through the left door
strings.hf.s28.title: Surveillance Room
strings.hf.s28.body: The screens show the hallways. On one of them, you see yourself... but with a one-second delay. The lag is always the same.
strings.hf.s28.c3: Go back to the evacuation map
strings.hf.s29.title: Backtrack
strings.hf.s29.body: You marked the wall. But the mark is no longer in the right place: it is on a door. And that door did not exist before.
strings.hf.s30.title: Operating Room
strings.hf.s30.body: The OR is lit up. The lamps warm the air softly. The table is ready, draped, as if for an imminent procedure. But no one is there.
strings.hf.s31.title: Instrument Tray
strings.hf.s31.body: The instruments are lined up. A pair of gloves lies on the edge, still clean, as if they had just come out of the package.
strings.hf.s31.c2: Take the gloves and back away
strings.hf.s32.title: Recovery Room
strings.hf.s32.body: You find yourself behind a curtain. A soft beep follows you. On your wrist, a trace of glue... like a sensor was ripped off.
strings.hf.s32.c1: Pull the curtain aside and get out
strings.hf.s32.c3: Fall asleep again for a second
strings.hf.s33.title: Gurney Hallway
strings.hf.s33.body: Gurneys are lined up against the wall. One of them moves ever so slightly on its own, as if something had just settled on it.
strings.hf.s34.title: Locker Room
strings.hf.s34.body: Lockers. Scrubs. And inside a half-open locker, a badge with an unreadable name. You hear the scratching of a pen behind a door.
strings.hf.s34.c2: Take a scrub top and go through the door on the right
strings.hf.s34.c3: Go back to the gurney hallway
strings.hf.s35.title: Waste Room
strings.hf.s35.body: Black bags. Bleach smell. A metal door: "MORGUE." A hatch in the floor may lead to the archives.
strings.hf.s36.title: Morgue
strings.hf.s36.body: The light is too white. The metal drawers are shut... except for one, slightly open. A cold breath escapes from it.
strings.hf.s36.c2: Back away and shut the door
strings.hf.s37.title: Patient 0 File
strings.hf.s37.body: Inside the drawer: a cardboard file. No body. Just your file, placed there instead of a body. On the first page: "STATUS: IN PROGRESS."
strings.hf.s38.title: The Page Writes Itself
strings.hf.s38.body: Right in front of you, a line types itself: "The patient is reading this. He thinks he is alone." The next sentence starts... but stops when you hold your breath.
strings.hf.s38.c1: Close it and run for the exit
strings.hf.s39.title: The Exit Door
strings.hf.s39.body: An "EXIT" door with a push bar. On the other side: cold air. But also... a very faint keyboard sound.
strings.hf.s39.c1: Push the bar and go out
strings.hf.s39.c3: Press your ear against the door, then go out if everything stays quiet
strings.hf.s40.title: The Courtyard
strings.hf.s40.body: You are outside, in the courtyard. The walls are too high. The gated exit to the street is there... but the lock looks new, shiny.
strings.hf.s41.title: The Air Outside
strings.hf.s41.body: You breathe in. The air outside is cold and normal. Then your phone vibrates: "Reminder: consultation in progress." You never made an appointment.
strings.hf.s41.c1: Force the gate to the street
strings.hf.s42.title: The Figure in Scrubs
strings.hf.s42.body: At the end of the hallway visible through a glass door, someone walks by in scrubs. You cannot see their face. They are pushing a cart. As if the shift were still going on.
strings.hf.s42.c3: Take advantage of the moment and bolt
strings.hf.s43.title: The "Consultation"
strings.hf.s43.body: The figure in scrubs turns around. Still no face, just a blurred area. A clear voice says: "The patient must present himself." The OR table is ready, sheet pulled tight, tools in place.
strings.hf.s44.title: Setup
strings.hf.s44.body: You feel straps. The beep gets louder. A sentence appears on a screen: "Without proof, back to the OR." You try to catch your breath.
strings.hf.s45.title: Proof
strings.hf.s45.body: You are holding proof. Audio, video, or file. Something that says: "This place lies." The security screens crackle as if they do not like it.
strings.hf.s46.title: Validation
strings.hf.s46.body: Behind a door with no handle, an office. A computer types on its own. On the screen: "PATIENT 0 — STATUS: PENDING." A stamp marked "VALIDATED" waits there, ink still fresh.
strings.hf.s47.title: The Final Choice
strings.hf.s47.body: The gate to the street is in front of you. One last time, you hear the keyboard. As if the hospital is waiting for you to choose your ending.
strings.hf.s47.c3: See the truth through to the end
strings.hf.s48.title: Last Hallway
strings.hf.s48.body: You move toward the gate. The metal is cold. Behind you, the courtyard door slowly closes without a sound. Everything becomes unnaturally quiet.
strings.hf.s48.c1: Push the gate and do not look back
strings.hf.end_good.title: Ending — Escape
strings.hf.end_good.body: You get through the gate. The morning air burns your lungs. Behind you, the hospital stays perfectly still. You do not know everything yet. But one thing is certain: this night will never leave you.
strings.hf.end_bad.title: Ending — Back to the OR
strings.hf.end_bad.body: The ceiling light blinds you. The beep becomes one continuous sound. Somewhere, someone writes: "Patient presented. Shift validated." And you understand that here, there was never really any exit.
strings.hf.end_secret.title: Secret Ending — Assignment
strings.hf.end_secret.body: The stamp comes down. "VALIDATED." The screen displays: "On-duty staff: active." The keyboard stops. The door closes. You understand then that the place had been waiting for someone to take over.
strings.hf.clue.has_bracelet.title: Patient Wristband
strings.hf.clue.has_bracelet.desc: A warm wristband, as if someone had just fastened it on you.
strings.hf.clue.has_keycard.title: Access Card
strings.hf.clue.has_keycard.desc: A staff keycard. It opens doors that should no longer work.
strings.hf.clue.has_tape.title: On-duty Cassette
strings.hf.clue.has_tape.desc: A cassette from the tape recorder: a voice noting schedules... and your name.
strings.hf.clue.has_recording.title: CCTV Recording
strings.hf.clue.has_recording.desc: Video proof: the hallway moves while the camera does not.
strings.hf.clue.has_dossier.title: Patient 0 File
strings.hf.clue.has_dossier.desc: Your file. It keeps filling itself in as you breathe.
strings.hf.h.s12.soft: You now have something the hospital "recognizes."
strings.hf.h.s12.strong: The wristband opens or changes doors and makes the secret path possible.
strings.hf.h.s18.soft: The tape recorder is not there by accident.
strings.hf.h.s18.strong: Take the cassette: it counts as proof and for the secret ending.
strings.hf.h.s22.soft: Everything that still works is often found in security.
strings.hf.h.s22.strong: Take the access card: it unlocks archives, surveillance, and the OR.
strings.hf.h.s28.soft: If you can prove the hallway moves, you can break the loop.
strings.hf.h.s28.strong: Start the recording: without proof, some exits will send you back to the OR.
strings.hf.h.s37.soft: The file concerns you more than you think.
strings.hf.h.s37.strong: Take the file: it is the strongest proof, and a key to the full truth.
strings.hf.h.s47.soft: You can finish quickly... or go further.

hf.tagline: In a hospital closed for years, your name is already in the records. Between an admission badge, a patient wristband, Room 14, and rooms still lit up, everything suggests your arrival was expected.
hf.s11.body: The bed is unmade, still warm near the pillow. On the bedside table: a patient wristband. The heart monitor is off, but its indicator lights are blinking slowly.
